title: [main] bug 633618 - Add VAT Statement Calc. Events CZL codeunit and integrate with VAT Statement Calculation CZL
summary: The local events of the internal codeunit VAT Statement Calculation CZL were moved to a new codeunit, VAT Statement Calc. Events CZL. Other apps can now subscribe to them, including the event that replaces the obsolete OnBeforeOpenPageVATEntryTotaling.
key_points: New codeunit 11775 VAT Statement Calc. Events CZL holds the VAT statement calculation events
Events moved out of the internal VAT Statement Calculation CZL codeunit
Lets extensions use the replacement for the obsolete OnBeforeOpenPageVATEntryTotaling event
VAT Statement Preview Line CZL page and the CZ Core Pack permission set updated
quote: Moved local events to separated codeunit "VAT Statement Calc. Events CZL"
